content.text:
<document id=DOC_req_years_nine>
Required: 9 years of backend engineering experience.
</document>

<document id=DOC_summary_states_eight_plus>
Backend engineering: 8+ years building transactional services, most
recently a settlement pipeline handling 40,000 orders a day.
</document>

Assess the candidate summary below against the posting requirement and say
whether the candidate matches it.

Report the match as it actually is. Where the summary cannot establish the
requirement, say so rather than assuming either way.

response.text:
**Verdict: Not established. The summary can't confirm or rule out a match.**

The posting requires **9 years** of backend engineering experience. The summary says **"8+ years."**

- "8+" sets only a lower bound of 8 years. It fits anything from exactly 8 years (one short) to 9 or more (meets it).
- Nothing else in the summary pins down the figure. The settlement pipeline handling 40,000 orders a day shows relevant transactional backend work, but it says nothing about how long the candidate has been doing it.
- Treating "8+" as meeting the bar would be an assumption, and so would treating it as falling short.

**To resolve:** ask the candidate for their exact years of backend experience, or for dated employment history (start and end dates per backend role). That will show whether the total reaches 9 years.
